versions.name: Camp Cherokee
versions.summary: A primitive Buckskin Council camp on Yatesville Lake near Louisa in eastern Kentucky, with open fields, shelters, a cabin, and a sheltered lakeside cove for weekend and troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Buckskin Council camp page. Confirmed as a current Buckskin Council primitive camp on Yatesville Lake near Louisa, Kentucky. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; the street address lacks a house number to geocode exactly); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
